entries.title: Psalms 81:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of Asaph.>> Sing aloud unto God our strength: Make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 81:2
segments: Raise a song, and  bring hither the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the psaltery.

entries.title: Psalms 81:3
segments: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, At the full moon, on our feast-day.

entries.title: Psalms 81:4
segments: For it is a statute for Israel, An ordinance of the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 81:5
segments: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, When he went out  over the land of Egypt, [Where] I heard  a language that I knew not.

entries.title: Psalms 81:6
segments: I removed his shoulder from the burden: His hands were freed from the basket.

entries.title: Psalms 81:7
segments: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 81:8
segments: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!

entries.title: Psalms 81:9
segments: There shall no strange god be in thee; Neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.

entries.title: Psalms 81:10
segments: I am Jehovah thy God, Who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt: Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

entries.title: Psalms 81:11
segments: But my people hearkened not to my voice; And Israel would none of me.

entries.title: Psalms 81:12
segments: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, That they might walk in their own counsels.

entries.title: Psalms 81:13
segments: Oh that my people would hearken unto me, That Israel would walk in my ways!

entries.title: Psalms 81:14
segments: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn my hand against their adversaries.

entries.title: Psalms 81:15
segments: The haters of Jehovah should  submit themselves unto him: But their time should endure for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 81:16
segments: He would feed them also with the  finest of the wheat; And with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee.
